comment: SaDockerLayoutFit, SaDockerLayoutRefit and SaDockerEmbedFlip live in ui/layout/fit. This runs the three for the same rectangles: the boot's fit of the default at 1920 by 1080, the refit on a 1280 by 1024 window and at 125 per cent, and the flip that lets the dockers out of the main window and takes them back in.
